description: Returns a Mobiscroll Connect concept guide, checked against the API and SDK source: token lifecycle and persistence, scopes and partial consent, paging, times and all-day events, event ids and recurring events, writing events, webhooks, errors and rate limits, disconnect vs revoke, the Connect pages, environments and limits, and a recipe for showing Connect events in a Mobiscroll Eventcalendar. Call without topic to list the guides.

topic.description: Guide topic id, e.g. "token-lifecycle". Omit to list every guide.
